name: Brewmeister Bilger
summary: Brewmeister Bilger waits in Southshore's inn cellar for deliveries from distant lands. The intoxicated dwarf passes his hours tasting potent spirits.

sections.title: Life in the Cellar
sections.body: Brewmeister Bilger paces the cellar beneath Southshore's inn, nursing hiccups as he seeks the strongest brews Azeroth can offer.

sections.title: A Taste for Potent Imports
sections.body: Brewmeister Bilger can judge spirits despite his constant stupor. He favors heavy dwarven moonshines and potent southern liquors, and eagerly receives special batches such as the moonshine Foggy MacKreel sends from the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Where can I find Brewmeister Bilger?
faq.answer: Find Brewmeister Bilger in the cellar beneath the inn at Southshore, the Alliance port town in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Brewmeister Bilger receives rare liquor from the Wetlands, including strong spirits such as MacKreel's Moonshine, shipped north to Southshore.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see Bilger's love of strong drink thriving in a human port town far from Ironforge.
As an Alliance member, you can find Bilger in Southshore's inn cellar, one of the dwarves who make their home among the humans of this beleaguered town.
